label: Phase two — the strangest crossing
location: The Drowned Vault, the ferry landing

recentEvents.value: He explained that the surf walls wash toward the door, never under; the stranger heard him and named a rescue an attack.

unresolvedConflicts.value: The passenger understands the schedule perfectly and refuses it on principle.

temporaryObjective.value: Stop offering the ride; start steering the water.

notes: 'You understand every word I say, don't you? Then this is the strangest crossing I have ever worked.'
